passages.provision_quote: The right to marry is a fundamental right.
passages.note: ACA5 repeals the opposite-sex-only marriage clause and declares marriage a fundamental right without stating anti-discrimination protections (rung 1) or a religious-organization exemption (rung 3).
Wiener is listed among the Ayes on the 07/13/23 Senate Floor vote on ACA5, which passed with zero Noes.
passages.tally_quote: Ayes Count 31 Noes Count 0 NVR Count 9

rows.reasoning: Wiener voted Aye on ACA 5 (2023-2024) on the Senate Floor, which repeals the opposite-sex-only marriage clause and states only that 'the right to marry is a fundamental right,' showing support for marriage equality but not addressing the discrimination-protection clause that distinguishes rung 1 or the religious-organization exemption that distinguishes rung 3. The Senate Floor vote itself passed with zero Noes, so it is near-unanimous and cannot alone establish a chair.
